verdict.rationale: MultiPass FIDO Security Key explicitly supports NFC as one of three interfaces and is documented compatible with Android/iOS platforms, implying tap-to-authenticate via NFC on mobile; however, evidence doesn't explicitly confirm NFC (vs BLE) works with specific mobile browsers/apps or provide hands-on confirmation. missing for 10: explicit mobile browser/app NFC tap walkthrough, independent hands-on verification of NFC mobile authentication.
